indicator_name: Total Tax and Payment Arrears Owed to the Budget
description: Недоимка по налогам и платежам в бюджет
methodology: Million KZT. Total overdue tax and payment debt ('недоимка') owed to the republican budget by taxpayers, as of January 1 of the stated year -- distinct from GOV_ACCOUNTS_RECEIVABLE (which covers the budget's own settlement-level arrears, not unpaid taxpayer debt). Point-in-time snapshot, not a flow. earlier points restored on 2026-09-25 from bulletins archived in data/raw/minfin (no longer in the gov.kz listing). 1 January 2025 = 434 785 as every 2025-Q1 and 2026 edition states it; the Jun-Nov 2025 editions put 508 222.9 (the 1 January 2024 figure) under that date and are not used for it.
